meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创作或编辑自定义视频合成作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作多场景视频、品牌短片或自由形式的视频合成。
copy.tagline_en: Create or edit custom video compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce multi-scene videos, brand reels, or freeform video compositions.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的需求创作或编辑视频项目，包括多场景短片、品牌宣传片、蒙太奇、静态循环、标题卡、素材混剪等。它会先检查项目状态，然后生成计划、构建场景，并处理媒体资源。
howto.when: 当没有更专门的流程适用，或 BRIEF.md 中指定 flow: companion 时触发。适用于较长或多场景的作品、品牌宣传片、蒙太奇等。

say.text: 帮我做一个30秒的品牌宣传片，展示我们的新产品。
编辑这个视频项目，把第三场景的动画改成淡入效果。
say.note: Claude 会读取现有项目状态并执行指定编辑。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create or edit video projects including multi-scene pieces, brand reels, montages, static loops, title cards, and footage remixes. It checks project state, generates a plan, builds scenes, and handles media assets.
howto.when_en: Triggered when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds.

say_en.text: Create a 30-second brand reel showcasing our new product.
say_en.note: Claude will start the general-video workflow, generate a plan, and build scenes.

say_en.text: Edit this video project and change the animation in scene 3 to a fade-in.
say_en.note: Claude will read the existing project state and perform the specified edit.
